Run Grafana with the logs and metrics.

It runs in a container on this machine, under Docker or Podman, and reads the log files of the home; the daemon sends its metrics to it at otel.endpoint.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`wdx observe start`](#wdx-observe-start) | Start Grafana with the logs and metrics |
| [`wdx observe status`](#wdx-observe-status) | Show whether Grafana is running |
| [`wdx observe stop`](#wdx-observe-stop) | Stop Grafana |

## wdx observe start

Start Grafana with the logs and metrics.

```sh
wdx observe start [flags]
```

Waits until the stack is ready: the grafana/otel-lgtm image, with Grafana on 127.0.0.1:3000 and the collector the daemon sends its metrics to on 127.0.0.1:4318. The first start pulls the image, which can take minutes. It runs until stopped, and its data stays across starts.

### Examples

```sh
# Start Grafana, then open the URL it prints
wdx observe start
```

### Output

The stack, already running or started, and where to open Grafana. With `--json`: {"result": ..., "stack": {...}, "data\_removed": null}

With `--json`, `result` is one of: `running` or `started`.

### Errors

| Code | Exit | When |
|---|---|---|
| [`port_in_use`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#port_in_use) | 1 | a port the observability stack needs is taken |
| [`runtime_failed`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#runtime_failed) | 3 | Docker or Podman failed |
| [`runtime_missing`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#runtime_missing) | 3 | neither Docker nor Podman is installed |
| [`usage`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#usage) | 2 | the request, command line or a setting is invalid |
| [`internal`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#internal) | 3 | an unexpected failure: database, filesystem or git |

## wdx observe status

Show whether Grafana is running.

```sh
wdx observe status [flags]
```

Show whether Grafana is running

### Examples

```sh
# Show whether Grafana is running
wdx observe status
```

### Output

Whether the stack is running, under which runtime, and its container: where to open Grafana, where it takes metrics and which logs it reads. With `--json`: {"running": ..., "runtime": ..., "stack": {...}}

### Errors

| Code | Exit | When |
|---|---|---|
| [`runtime_failed`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#runtime_failed) | 3 | Docker or Podman failed |
| [`usage`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#usage) | 2 | the request, command line or a setting is invalid |
| [`internal`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#internal) | 3 | an unexpected failure: database, filesystem or git |

## wdx observe stop

Stop Grafana.

```sh
wdx observe stop [--purge] [flags]
```

The stack's container is removed. Its data, the logs and metrics it stored, stays for the next start unless `--purge` is given.

### Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--purge` |  | also remove the stack's data |

### Examples

```sh
# Stop Grafana and keep its data
wdx observe stop

# Stop it and remove its data
wdx observe stop --purge
```

### Output

Whether the stack was stopped and, with `--purge`, whether its data was removed. With `--json`: {"result": ..., "stack": null, "data\_removed": ...}

With `--json`, `result` is one of: `not_running` or `stopped`.

### Errors

| Code | Exit | When |
|---|---|---|
| [`runtime_failed`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#runtime_failed) | 3 | Docker or Podman failed |
| [`runtime_missing`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#runtime_missing) | 3 | neither Docker nor Podman is installed |
| [`usage`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#usage) | 2 | the request, command line or a setting is invalid |
| [`internal`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#internal) | 3 | an unexpected failure: database, filesystem or git |
